proposals.title: Shipment Zero: Report on Retirement Plan Options Alignment with Climate Goals
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a board report reviewing retirement plan investment options and assessing alignment of current options with Amazon's climate action goals, including a low-carbon default option.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on retirement plan options.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting a Report on Customer Due Diligence
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent third-party report assessing whether customers' use of surveillance, computer vision, or cloud products contributes to human rights violations.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on customer due diligence.

proposals.title: Policy to Include Hourly Employees as Director Candidates
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring the initial list of board candidates to include hourly employees, to promote employee representation in board decisions.
proposals.evidence: RECOMMENDATION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS ON ITEM 7 Why We Recommend You Vote Against This Proposal

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting a Report on Plastics Use
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a board report on how Amazon could reduce plastics use in packaging in line with the Pew Report's reduction findings to address ocean pollution.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on packaging materials.

proposals.title: Board Report on Worker Health and Safety Disparities
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report examining whether health and safety practices create racial and gender disparities in warehouse worker injury rates and their career impact.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on worker health and safety differences.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting Additional Reporting on Risks Associated with the Use of Certain Contract Clauses
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a public report assessing risks from employee concealment clauses that may limit discussion of harassment, discrimination and other unlawful acts.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting additional reporting on risks associated with the use of certain contract clauses.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting a Report on Charitable Contributions
proposals.topic_summary: Requests semi-annual website disclosure itemizing all charitable donations above $999 by recipient, with policies and rationale for each contribution.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on charitable contributions.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting Alternative Tax Reporting
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a tax transparency report prepared under the GRI Tax Standard, including revenues, profits and taxes by jurisdiction.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting alternative tax reporting.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting Additional Reporting on Freedom of Association
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report analyzing how Amazon's human rights policies protect freedom of association and collective bargaining rights under ILO and UN standards.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting additional reporting on freedom of association.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting Additional Reporting on Lobbying
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual disclosure of lobbying policies, direct and indirect lobbying and grassroots payments with recipients, and board oversight of such payments.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting additional reporting on lobbying.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting a Policy Requiring More Director Candidates Than Board Seats
proposals.topic_summary: Requests reform of board elections so the company lists more director candidates than seats to be filled, giving shareholders more choice.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a policy requiring more director candidates than board seats.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting a Report on Warehouse Working Conditions
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent audit and report on working conditions and treatment of warehouse workers, including effects of policies, performance metrics and targets.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on warehouse working conditions.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting Additional Reporting on Gender/Racial Pay
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on median pay gaps across race and gender, including associated policy, reputational and recruiting risks.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting additional reporting on gender/racial pay.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting a Diversity and Equity Audit
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a racial equity audit analyzing Amazon's impacts on civil rights, diversity, equity and inclusion and their effects on the business.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a diversity and equity audit.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting a Report on Customer Use of Certain Technologies
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent study of Rekognition facial recognition risks to privacy, civil rights, and sales to repressive governments, with reporting by September 2022.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on customer use of certain technologies.
